Recently arrived and ready for adventure, this 2016 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Sahara 4WD in bold Rhino Clearcoat delivers legendary capability, rugged styling, and open-air freedom. With 132,244 miles on the odometer and an original MSRP of $44,640, this Wrangler represents an excellent opportunity to own one of the most iconic off-road SUVs ever built.

Under the hood, this Wrangler is powered by a proven 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine, paired with a 5-Speed Automatic Transmission and Jeep's highly capable 4WD system. This powertrain is well known for its durability and off-road capability, giving you the confidence to tackle trails, rough terrain, or challenging weather conditions while still providing comfortable on-road performance.

The Sahara trim offers a refined blend of rugged capability and premium comfort. The exterior is enhanced by stylish 18-inch x 7.5-inch 7-Spoke Polished Aluminum Wheels, while the Body-Color 3-Piece Hard Top allows you to enjoy the classic Wrangler open-air driving experience. The removable Freedom Panels make it easy to bring in fresh air and sunshine whenever you want, and the included Freedom Panel Storage Bag helps keep everything protected when the panels are removed.

This Wrangler is also equipped for towing and adventure with the Max Tow Package, Class II Receiver Hitch, 3.73 Rear Axle Ratio, and Trailer Tow Wiring with 4-Pin Connector, giving you the ability to bring along additional gear for your next trip.

Inside, the cabin offers a comfortable and well-equipped environment with Leather Trimmed Bucket Seats, Heated Front Seats, and a Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel that add premium touches to the rugged interior. The Driver Height Adjuster Seat, Front Seat Back Map Pockets, and thoughtful interior storage features help make everyday driving more convenient.

Technology features include the Uconnect system with a 6.5-inch Touchscreen Display, GPS Navigation, and the Radio 430N infotainment system. Entertainment and connectivity options include SiriusXM Travel Link, Audio Jack Input for Mobile Devices, Remote USB Port, and Uconnect Voice Command with Bluetooth, allowing you to stay connected while on the road. The system also includes a 40GB Hard Drive with 28GB Available, providing additional space for media storage.

Additional driver information and convenience features include a Vehicle Information Center, Tire Pressure Monitoring Display, Rear Window Defroster, and Rear Window Wiper/Washer, helping improve visibility and awareness in a variety of conditions.

As expected from Jeep, this Wrangler is built for durability and capability. With its rugged construction, four-wheel-drive system, and versatile design, it remains one of the most popular vehicles for drivers who enjoy outdoor adventures, trail exploration, or simply want a vehicle with unmistakable character.

It's important to note that this vehicle does not include a warranty and is sold completely as-is.

The 2024 Lamborghini Huracan Sterrato is the wild child of the Huracan family––an off-road-blessed supercar built to defy convention. It retains the raw emotion and performance of a Huracan but adds increased ride height and rugged capability, allowing its driver to explore beyond the tarmac without worry. Mounted behind the driver is a 5.2-liter naturally aspirated V10, producing 602 horsepower and 417 lb-ft of torque. With a 0-60 mph time of just 3.3 seconds the Huracan Sterrato delivers relentless acceleration and an intoxicating exhaust note that builds to a howling crescendo at 8,000+ rpm. What sets the Sterrato apart is its purpose-built design for the road less traveled. Ride height is raised by 44 mm compared to the Huracan EVO, while wider tracks, reinforced underbody protection, aluminum skid plates, and flared fenders create a stance that's both functional and ferocious. Inside, the cabin is trimmed in Nero Ade leather/alcantara featuring Verde Selvans accents and carbon fiber throughout. The center console houses an 8.4-inch touchscreen with smartphone connectivity and performance telemetry. The Lamborghini Huracan Sterrato is a celebration of freedom and defiance of the norm. It's proof that a Lamborghini's heart can beat just as loudly off the beaten path as it does on the open road.

description: The 2014 RAM ProMaster 1500 136 WB 3-door High Roof Cargo Van is a purpose-built commercial vehicle designed to deliver maximum cargo capacity, ease of use, and dependable performance for businesses and professionals. Built on a front-wheel-drive platform, the ProMaster stands out in its class for offering a combination of generous interior volume and maneuverability that makes it equally suited to city streets and highway routes. Its clean, utilitarian design reflects a focus on function over flair, with every aspect of the vehicle engineered around productivity and versatility for work environments. Powering the ProMaster 1500 is a robust naturally aspirated V6 gasoline engine paired with an automatic transmission that’s tuned for smooth power delivery under load. While it’s not a high-performance powertrain, it generates enough torque to move heavy cargo, handle frequent stop-and-go driving, and tow moderate loads when equipped. The front-wheel-drive layout helps lower the floor height and enhances traction during loading, improves fuel economy compared with some rear-wheel-drive competitors, and makes the van easy to control even when fully laden. Exterior styling is straightforward and purposeful. The high roof design provides generous vertical space, allowing cargo to stack taller and enabling standing room inside without custom modification. The wide sliding side doors and large rear swing-open doors make loading and unloading more efficient, whether you’re handling bulky equipment, shelving units, or palletized goods. The tall, flat sides also make the ProMaster an excellent candidate for vehicle decals or business branding, giving commercial operators both space and visibility for their logos and information. Inside, the cargo area is expansive and thoughtfully designed. The long-wheelbase (136-inch) configuration maximizes usable space, offering a nearly uninterrupted load floor that can be tailored with shelving, racks, or other storage solutions specific to a trade or business need. Tie-down points and cargo-securement features enhance safety and organization on the job. The high-roof option further increases usable cubic footage, so professionals such as electricians, plumbers, couriers, and mobile service providers can carry tools and parts without feeling cramped. The driver’s cabin is straightforward and durable, with controls placed for ease of access and materials chosen to withstand heavy daily use. Seating is comfortable enough for long work shifts, and visibility is excellent thanks to large windows and a commanding driving position. Standard convenience features address basic needs, while available upgrades such as an infotainment system, Bluetooth connectivity, and backup camera can improve comfort and usability for drivers on the road. On the road, the ProMaster handles its size well, with predictable steering and braking that make it manageable in urban traffic as well as on rural roads. The suspension is tuned more for load-carrying stability than sporty handling, delivering a stable, confidence-inspiring ride under typical commercial conditions. In summary, the 2014 RAM ProMaster 1500 136 WB 3-door High Roof Cargo Van is a hardworking and flexible commercial vehicle that emphasizes cargo capacity, accessibility, and everyday reliability, making it an excellent choice for businesses needing a dependable work van.

Convenience
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
